item.description:
Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

What's new

  • See whether unsubscribing worked. In Subscriptions, each sender you've unsubscribed from shows how it was handled: confirmed by the sender, or finished by email or on their web page. If a sender keeps emailing you more than two days after you unsubscribe, they move back to the top marked Still emailing you, with a Try Again button.
  • A cleaner "Sending…" panel. While a message waits to send, you see a countdown ring, who it's going to, and a short preview of the message, with Undo Send next to the countdown.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Improvements

  • Subscriptions now hides senders you've unsubscribed from (use "Show unsubscribed" at the bottom to see them). Right after unsubscribing, Archive is highlighted — unsubscribing stops new mail, and Archive clears out what's already in your Inbox.

Beta release — please send feedback from Help › Send Feedback.

Bug fixes

  • Pasting into an email works again. Text and tables copied from other emails no longer paste in as invisible text in dark mode — they keep their layout and match your message's colors.
  • Undo after pasting. ⌘Z now undoes a paste.
